lessons.title: Open a recording
lessons.ask: Open a **recording** on Watch. The Match menu lists the recordings of the library, and a file dropped on the page opens too.
lessons.praise: The recording plays. `Space` pauses it and plays it again.

agent.goal: The library holds a recording outside the Trash.

steps.say: Add the five a side sample to the library.
List the recordings of the library with the server running.
Open it in the browser, which a person sees.

lessons.title: Jump to a goal
lessons.ask: **Jump to a goal** of the recording. `N` goes to the next goal, the Match menu lists every goal, and a click on the timeline seeks.
lessons.praise: There is the goal. `R` replays it from other angles.

agent.goal: A page that a script drives jumps to a goal, and the page reports the lesson.

steps.say: Open the sample on the page.
Jump to the next goal, as N does.
Read the moment from the address of the page.

lessons.title: Switch the camera
lessons.ask: **Switch to another camera**. `V` cycles the cameras, and the View menu lists them all.
lessons.praise: A new angle. `V` again cycles on, and the free camera flies with `W`, `A`, `S` and `D`.

agent.goal: A page that a script drives shows another camera, and the page reports the lesson.

steps.say: Choose the tactical camera.
Read the camera that shows.

lessons.title: Follow a player
lessons.ask: **Follow one player**. A number key from `1` to `0` puts the view on a player of the left team, over the shoulder, `P` follows the player on the ball, and the View menu has Follow player.
lessons.praise: The camera stays with the player. `Esc` returns to the broadcast camera.

agent.goal: A page that a script drives follows a player, and the page reports the lesson.

steps.say: Pick the first player of the left team.
Follow that player.

lessons.title: Play for 30 seconds
lessons.ask: Start a game on Play and play **30 seconds** of match time. `Left` `Right` `Up` `Down` move, `D` shoots, and a controller works too.
lessons.praise: Thirty seconds played. `Esc` pauses the game, and **Quit saves it** to Recordings.

agent.goal: The library holds a game or a requested match of at least 300 steps, 30 seconds of match time.

steps.say: Record a short match of five a side between the built in AIs, or name registered teams with --left and --right.
From Python, play two teams of the registry.

lessons.title: Register a team
lessons.ask: **Register a team** on the Teams page. Upload a submission folder with a `main.py`, or add the starter team that Cuju ships.
lessons.praise: The team joins the lists of Play, Matches and Tournaments. **Choose it on Teams** to dress it.

agent.goal: The registry holds a team besides the built in AI.

steps.say: Register the starter team that cuju ships.
Or register a submission folder of your own.
steps.run: cuju render team add path/to/submission --name "My team"

steps.say: List the teams.

lessons.title: Start a challenge
lessons.ask: **Start a challenge** from the Challenges page. Play it yourself plays it on Play, and Run a model plays it with a registered model.
lessons.praise: The challenge is on. Every attempt plays a **fixed seed**, so every result compares.

agent.goal: The library holds an attempt of a headless challenge, or a leaderboard holds a run.

steps.say: List the challenges.
Play one attempt with the built in AI as practice.

lessons.title: Make a photo
lessons.ask: **Make a photo** of a moment. Photo mode opens from the View menu, `P` saves the photo, and `Esc` leaves.
lessons.praise: A photo of the match. The **looks** and the **guides** of photo mode change its style.

agent.goal: A page that a script drives captures a photo, and the page reports the lesson.

steps.say: Open photo mode.
Capture a photo as a PNG data URL.
Leave photo mode.
